premises.text: Physical house keys are often lost or not returned when shared with friends and service people
premises.evidence_span: sometimes I hand out keys to friends and I don't get them back

premises.text: Plug-and-play hardware lets a smartphone open multifamily front and apartment doors without changing the downstairs lock
premises.evidence_span: there's no changes at the front door downstairs

premises.text: An internet-controlled apartment lock partnered with brands like Kwikset delivers security and reliability
premises.evidence_span: we partner with big brands like Kwikset, who enable us to provide you with a maximum of security and reliability

premises.text: Users can remotely unlock, pre-share temporary keys, and monitor who accessed when
premises.evidence_span: you can share keys with your friends, guests. You can set temporary keys. And you can remove them any time

premises.text: Regular keys or a PIN still work if the phone battery is low or the phone is lost
premises.evidence_span: you can still use your regular keys or a pin code to enter your apartment in case your battery runs low or your phone gets lost

value.text: Smartphone remote control of home doors with shareable digital keys and no key-handoff hassle
value.evidence_span: There's no more hassle to hand over the keys. You have full control

secondary_value.text: Know when babysitters, dog walkers, or cleaners enter and leave
secondary_value.evidence_span: Do you really know when your babysitter or your dog walker or your cleaner comes to your apartment and leaves it with Keezy you know?

causal_links.evidence_span: there's no more keys to be lost because the key always comes back
the smartphone becomes the remote control for your doors
I pre-share a key with them before they arrive, so the key is in their smartphone before they arrive
you can still use your regular keys or a pin code to enter your apartment
